top_signals.title: Bonds Drop With Stocks as Iran Tensions Boost Oil: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Bonds and stocks dropped as Middle East tensions flared following President Donald Trump’s rejection of Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, denting some of the optimism that lifted markets late last week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
